description: This file defines a wizard interface for processing point-of-sale payments in an Odoo (OpenERP) module, including functions for retrieving journals, initializing payment data, adding payments, validation, and invoice creation.

classes.name: pos_payment
classes.description: Wizard interface class for handling POS payment process, including states for validation, payment addition, invoice creation, and receipt printing.

methods.name: _get_journal
methods.description: Retrieves available cash journals for selection.

methods.name: _pre_init
methods.description: Prepares initial data for the payment wizard, including amount, journal, and date.

methods.name: _add_pay
methods.description: Adds a payment to the POS order and updates invoice_wanted status.

methods.name: _validate
methods.description: Validates the order lines before proceeding.

methods.name: _check
methods.description: Determines next action based on order payment status and whether invoice is wanted.

methods.name: _test_no_line
methods.description: Checks if the order has any lines; raises error if none.

methods.name: create_invoice
methods.description: Creates and finalizes invoice for the order if not already invoiced.
